name: SikaTile-410 Secure Set
paste:
SIKATILE®-410 SECURE SET: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaTile®-410 Secure Set, September 2023, Version 01.04 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sikatile-410-secureset.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaTile®-410 Secure Set where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2023, Version 01.04).
1.2 Product description.
    - SikaTile®-410 Secure Set is a multi-purpose premium sand & Silica free white tile and stone adhesive with patented DUST LESS® Technology that reduces airborne dust during mixing by up to 80% achieving improved air quality, better working conditions, less mess, and faster clean-up.
    - SikaTile®-410 Secure Set is perfectly designed for most tile and stone applications including submerged applications and over under-floor heating systems.
    - SikaTile®-410 Secure Set is exceptionally smooth and creamy to spread with high performance non slump capabilities for large format tile and stone applications.
    - SikaTile®-410 Secure Set is extremely low in VOC, sand free, and contains no respirable crystalline silica making if safer to use then conventional sanded cement based tile adhesives.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Suitable tile types include.
    - Large format porcelain, ceramic and stone tiles
    - Natural stone including marble, limestone, granite, sandstone, and slate, not suitable for moisture sensitive stone
    - Terracotta
    - Agglomerates / Terrazzo not sensitive to moisture
    - Glass tile and glass mosaic
    - Thin brick slip's
    - 7-day old concrete
    - Compressed cement boards
    - Fibre cement sheet / Ceramic Tile Underlay
    - Concrete masonry / rendered brick / blockwork
    - Sika approved under tile waterproofing membranes
    - Gypsum plasterboard (internal only)
    - 24-hour old cement-based screeds and renders
    - Autoclaved Aerated Concrete (AAC)
    - Sika® approved acoustic underlayment's
    - Under tile heating systems
    - Tile over tile, with suitable Sika primer
    - Internal and external wall and floors in wet areas and submerged areas such as pools and spas
    - Commercial and domestic internal and external wall and floor applications
    Suitable substrates include.
    Suitable areas of use include.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.10.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaTile®-410 Secure Set
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: A MULTI-PURPOSE SAND AND SILICA FREE WHITE TILE & STONE ADHESIVE WITH PATENTED DUSTLESS®TECHNOLOGY THAT REDUCES AIRBOURNE DUST DURING MIXING BY UP TO 80%.
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (September 2023, Version 01.04) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - AS ISO 13007: cited elsewhere in the data sheet; cited with a stated property or value. Where: Features (p.1); Product Information > Product declaration (p.1).
    - SCAQMD method 304-91: cited with a stated property or value. Where: Product Information > Volatile organic compound (VOC) content (p.2).
2.4 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Patented DUST LESS® technology
    - Silica free formulation
    - AS ISO 13007 - C2TES1 Classification
    - White adhesive, suitable for light and translucent stone
    - Suitable for early age screeds (24-hours)
    - Suitable for early age concrete (7-days)
    - Exceptionally smooth and creamy to spread
    - Suitable for under floor heating applications
    - Non slump adhesive to assist in fixing large format tile and stone and minimising tile lippage
    - Good early setting for grouting after 24 hours even in cold climates
2.5 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Product declaration: C2TES1 as per AS ISO 13007
    - Appearance and colour: White powder
    - Density: 1.5 kg/L
    - Volatile organic compound (VOC) content: Low VOC - 7g/L (SCAQMD method 304-91)
2.6 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: 20kg bags / 64 bags per pallet
    - Shelf life: Unopened bags can be stored for up to 12 months in a cool, dry and weatherproof environment.
    - Storage conditions: Store in cool, dry conditions, off ground, out of direct sunlight. High humidity shall reduce shelf life.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 General. Prepare substrates in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2023, Version 01.04) and the requirements below. Inspect the substrate against these requirements before application.
3.2 Substrate quality / pre-treatment.
    - All works shall be carried out in accordance with applicable Australian standards.
    - All substrates shall meet minimum deflection standards outlined in the relevant Australian Standards.
    - All substrates shall be free from loose friable materials, dust, debris, release agents, curing compounds, grease, sealers and other contaminating materials. Contaminated substrates must be mechanically prepared to expose at least 80% of the original substrate.
    - Substrates shall be even and true to 5mm in 3m when measured from the highest point. For large format tiles greater than 600mm x 600mm, substrates shall be even and true to 1.5mm in 600mm to minimise tile lippage.
    - For substrates that require a levelling compound use a suitable Sika® self-levelling underlayment.
3.3 Substrate quality / pre-treatment - Concrete substrates.
    - New concrete shall be 7 days old and be left with a wood float finish.
    - Steel trowel finished concrete is generally acceptable if the concrete allows water penetration.
    - Concrete above 35Mpa shall be mechanically prepared.
3.4 Substrate quality / pre-treatment - Cement board and sheeting. All boards and sheets must be fixed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and specifically designed for tiling.
3.5 Substrate quality / pre-treatment - Screeds & mortar beds. Sand cement screeds must be installed as per relevant Australian Standards and left for a minimum 24 hours prior to tiling. Screeds may need longer drying time in cold climates.
3.6 Substrate priming.
    | Application | Primer |
    | Porous & dense substrates | SikaTile 010 Secure Prime |
    | Non porous substrates & tile on tile | SikaTile 015 NPP |
    Contaminated substrates / water based epoxy coatings SikaTile 015 NPP
    Refer to relevant pds for primers for additional information.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (September 2023, Version 01.04) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Mixing ratio: 6.5 - 7 Litres of clean cool potable water per 20kg bag.
    - Pot Life: 2 hours
    - Open Time: 30 Minutes
    - Adjustability time: Up to 30 minutes
4.3 Consumption.
    | Notched trowel Size | Approximate coverage |
    | 6mm | 10m² |
    | 10mm | 7m² |
    Coverage shall depend on surface planarity, substrate porosity, and application technique. Consumption to be treated as a guide only.
4.4 Applied product ready for use.
    | USE | WAIT TIME |
    | Grouting | 24 hours |
    | Light foot traffic | 24 hours |
    | Wet area service | 3 days |
    | Full traffic | 5 Days |
    | Submerged applications - Pools & | 21 days prior to filling with water |
    | Spas |
    | Values determined in laboratory conditions at 23°C and 50% relative humidity. |
    | Higher temperatures will reduce wait times and lower temperature will increase wait times. |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
4.5 Equipment.
    - Personal protective equipment
    - Mixing pail
    - Slow speed mixing drill with stirring attachment (max 500 rpm)
    - Notched Trowel
4.6 Tile on tile applications.
    - Ensure all existing tiles are firmly fixed, loose or hollow tiles must be removed and the area repaired using a suitable repair mortar.
    - Existing tiles shall be adequately cleaned prior to the application of the primer.
    - Existing tiles shall be primed with SIkaTile 015 NPP and allowed to dry prior to tiling.
4.7 Mixing.
    - Measure the recommended amount of clean potable water in a clean mixing pail, gradually add the SikaTile®-410 Secure Set powder mixing with the drill until it reaches a smooth lump free trowel-able consistency.
    - Allow the mix to stand / slake for 5 minutes then restir for an additional minute.
    - Remix without adding additional water during the adhesives pot life.
4.8 Application.
    - Tiles shall be fixed in accordance with Australian Standards.
    - Ensure the back of tiles are from dust and contaminates.
    - Apply the adhesive with a notched trowel to the substrate to achieve minimum coverage requirement outlined in the relevant Australian Standards.
    - Adhesive notches should be applied in a single direction.
    - Apply tiles into the wet adhesive and break the adhesive notches to fully bed the tile in the adhesive layer. Ensure adequate coverage outlined in the Australlian Standards is achieved to both substrate and the back of tiles.
    - Tiles 400x400 and larger shall be back buttered as per relevant Australian Standards.
    - Clean excess adhesive out of the grout joints while the adhesive is still wet.
    - Expansion joints shall be installed as per relevant Australian Standards.
4.9 Cleaning of equipment. Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water prior to the adhesive setting. Adhesive that has set will require mechanical removal.
4.10 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Do not apply in temperatures below 5°C or above 35°C.
    - SikaTile®-410 Secure Set cannot be used directly over timber flooring, apply a suitable Ceramic Tile Underlay or reinforced screed prior to application.
    - Not suitable for use with moisture sensitive stone.
    - SikaTile®-410 Secure Set is not suitable for direct bonding of tiles over solvent based waterproofing membranes.
    - Not suitable for tile over tile in submerged applications.
    - Due to external influences efflorescence is beyond the control of the manufacturer.
    - SikaTile®-410 Secure Set is not suitable for tile and stone with resinous, or other coatings on the base of the tile or stone.
    - "Silica Free" refers to the fact that the product is formulated with no sand hence there is no crystalline Silica present. SikaTile®-410 Secure Set is produced in an environment where contamination is possible through processing and packaging.
    - For application externally above 3 metres use in conjunction with shelving angles or mechanical fixing systems.
    - Contact Sika® Australia for uses not mentioned in this document.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, measure and record the conditions in clause 5.2 and compare them with the manufacturer's limits. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Ambient air temperature. +5°C / +35°C
5.3 Conditions stated in the limitations. Also stated in the data sheet limitations (clause 4.10):
    - Do not apply in temperatures below 5°C or above 35°C.
    - Not suitable for use with moisture sensitive stone.
5.4 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.5 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaTile®-410 Secure Set, September 2023, Version 01.04, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/x/sikatile-410-secureset.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaTile 410 Secure Set, version 30/04/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/MSDS%20%20SikaTile-410%20Secure%20Set%20GHS7.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Safety Data Sheet (SDS) containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.2, and include the records in the project documentation.
